home.statementLead: STRATA makes a small, considered wardrobe: heavyweight basics, precise outerwear and tailoring that doesn't ask you to sit still.
home.statementBody: Every piece is developed in our London studio, cut from fabrics we'd wear ourselves and produced in limited runs with partner mills in Portugal, Italy and Japan. No seasons of filler, no loud logos — just clothes built in layers, designed to be worn hard and kept for years.
home.contactIntro: Questions about an order, sizing or a collaboration? Send us a note.
home.newsletterText: Get early access to new drops, exclusive releases and selected offers.

about.title:
Built in
layers.
about.storyLead: STRATA started in 2021 in a shared studio in East London, with one heavyweight tee and a refusal to make anything we wouldn't wear every day.
about.storyBody: Strata — layers of rock laid down over time. That's how we think about a wardrobe: built slowly, one essential on top of another, each piece strong enough to stand alone. We still design every garment in the same studio, still fit every sample on real bodies, and still produce in runs small enough that we know the people who make them.

principles.title: Weight is a feature
principles.body: We start with fabric. Heavy jersey, dense fleece, double-faced wool — materials with enough body to hold a silhouette without structure.

principles.title: Cut for movement
principles.body: Dropped shoulders, articulated knees, fluid tailoring. Every pattern is tested in motion, not on a mannequin.

principles.title: Quiet identity
principles.body: No oversized logos. The brand lives in the proportion, the collar, the weight of the hem — details you recognise without reading.

principles.title: Made to be kept
principles.body: Small runs, no discount cycles, restocks of the pieces that work. We would rather make less and make it last.

about.qualityTitle: Every piece is made to outlast the season it was designed for.
about.qualityBody: We work with seven family-run mills and factories in Portugal, Italy and Japan, audited annually for fair wages and working conditions. Our cottons are organic, our down is RDS-certified, our wools are traceable to source.

blocks.heading: Processing
blocks.body: Orders placed before 2 PM GMT on business days ship the same day from our London studio.

blocks.heading: Rates
blocks.body: Standard (4–7 business days): free over $150, otherwise $12. Express (1–3 business days): $28.

blocks.heading: Duties
blocks.body: Duties and taxes are included for the UK, EU, US, Canada, Australia and Japan. Other destinations may be charged local import duties on delivery.

blocks.heading: 30-day returns
blocks.body: Return unworn items with tags attached within 30 days of delivery.

blocks.heading: Exchanges
blocks.body: Exchanges are free. We'll ship the new size as soon as your return is scanned by the carrier.

blocks.heading: Refunds
blocks.body: Refunds are $8 and are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return arriving at our studio.

blocks.heading: How our clothes fit
blocks.body: Most tops are cut boxy or oversized. Take your usual size for the intended fit, or size down for a closer line. Every product page lists the fit and what size the model is wearing.

blocks.heading: Still unsure?
blocks.body: Email hello@strata.studio with your height and usual size and we'll recommend a size within 24 hours.

blocks.heading: Where's my order?
blocks.body: Your shipping confirmation email contains a live tracking link. Orders placed in this browser are listed in your Account.

blocks.heading: What we collect
blocks.body: We collect only what we need to process your order and, if you opt in, send you news about drops.

blocks.heading: How we use it
blocks.body: Your data is never sold. It is shared only with the payment, shipping and email providers that make the service work.

blocks.heading: Your rights
blocks.body: You can request access to or deletion of your data at any time: hello@strata.studio.

blocks.heading: Orders
blocks.body: All orders are subject to availability and confirmation of the order price.

blocks.heading: Pricing
blocks.body: Prices are shown in USD and include duties for supported regions.

blocks.heading: Governing law
blocks.body: These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales.

blocks.heading: Essential storage
blocks.body: We use your browser's local storage to remember your bag and wishlist. No third-party advertising cookies are set by this storefront.

products.name: Monolith Oversized Coat
products.description: A dropped-shoulder overcoat cut long and wide from a dense wool-melton. Built to sit over everything you own and still hang clean.
products.fit: Oversized. Take your usual size for the intended fit, size down for a closer line. Model is 187 cm and wears M.
products.care: Dry clean only. Brush after wear. Store on a wide-shouldered hanger.

products.name: Vault Down Jacket
products.description: Box-baffled down puffer in a matte-coated ripstop. Stand collar, storm flap and a cropped hem that stacks over wide trousers.
products.materials: Shell: 100% recycled nylon ripstop, PFC-free DWR. Fill: 90/10 RDS down.
products.fit: Relaxed, cropped at the hip. True to size.
products.care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle with down wash. Tumble dry low with dryer balls.

products.name: Axis Tailored Blazer
products.description: An unstructured, boyfriend-cut blazer with a softened shoulder and long line. Tailoring that moves like a jacket.
products.fit: Relaxed and elongated. Size down for a sharper fit.
products.care: Dry clean only. Steam to refresh.

products.name: Drift Wool Overcoat
products.description: A double-faced wool coat with raw-cut edges and a notched lapel. No lining, no excess — just weight, drape and a precise shoulder.
products.fit: Relaxed through the body. True to size.

products.name: Base Heavyweight Tee
products.description: The foundation. 300 gsm loopback jersey, boxy through the body with a dense 3 cm rib collar that holds its shape wash after wash.
products.care: Machine wash cold inside out. Dry flat. Do not tumble dry.

products.name: Form Heavyweight Hoodie
products.description: A 520 gsm brushed-back fleece hoodie with a double-layer hood and no drawcords. Cropped body, long sleeve, heavy by design.
products.fit: Oversized, slightly cropped. True to size.

products.name: Contour Rib Knit
products.description: A close-fitting high-neck knit in a sculpted 2×2 rib. Fully fashioned, so every seam is knitted in rather than sewn.
products.fit: Slim, second-skin fit. Size up for a relaxed line.
products.care: Hand wash cold or dry clean. Dry flat.

products.name: Plinth Pleated Trouser
products.description: High-rise, double-pleated and full-length. A fluid wool-blend twill that pools slightly at the shoe.
products.fit: Wide leg, high rise. True to size, 82 cm inseam.
products.care: Machine wash cold on delicate. Hang dry. Warm iron.

products.name: Shadow Cargo Trouser
products.description: A relaxed cargo in brushed cotton-nylon. Bellowed pockets sit flat until you need them. Drawcord hem to stack or taper.
products.fit: Relaxed, straight leg. True to size.
products.care: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low.

products.name: Grade Wide Denim
products.description: A low-slung wide leg in 13.5 oz Japanese selvedge. Stone-washed once, then left to break in with you.
products.fit: Loose, wide leg. Take your usual waist size.
products.care: Wash as little as possible, cold and inside out. Hang dry.

products.name: Section Overshirt
products.description: A panelled overshirt in waxed cotton canvas, with contrast top-stitching that maps the pattern. Wear open as a layer or closed as a shirt.
products.fit: Boxy and slightly cropped. True to size.

products.name: Level Court Sneaker
products.description: A low-profile court shoe in full-grain Italian leather on a stitched cupsole. No logos, nothing extra.
products.materials: Upper and lining: calf leather. Sole: natural rubber.
products.fit: True to size. Half sizes, take the next size up.
products.care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Condition leather every few months.

products.name: Ingot Leather Bag
products.description: A soft, gathered shoulder bag in vegetable-tanned lambskin. Holds a day's essentials; folds nearly flat when empty.
products.care: Keep away from direct heat and water. Store in dust bag.

products.name: Aperture Sunglasses
products.description: A narrow rectangular frame hand-cut from Mazzucchelli acetate, fitted with category 3 polarised lenses.
products.fit: Medium fit. Lens 52 mm, bridge 20 mm, temple 145 mm.
products.care: Clean with the provided cloth. Store in case.

products.name: Ridge Rib Beanie
products.description: A deep-turn-up fisherman beanie in chunky merino rib. Woven tonal label, nothing louder.

products.name: Signal Varsity Jacket
products.description: A cropped varsity in boiled wool with leather sleeves and a single chenille initial. Collegiate proportions, re-cut for now.
details: Striped rib collar, cuffs and hem
products.materials: Body: 80% wool, 20% polyamide. Sleeves: lamb leather.
products.fit: Cropped and boxy. True to size.

products.name: Signal Oversized Tee
products.description: An exaggerated tee with a longer body and elbow-length sleeve. Screen-printed back graphic in water-based ink.
products.fit: Very oversized. Size down for a regular oversized fit.
products.care: Machine wash cold inside out. Do not iron print.

products.name: Ridge Shearling Jacket
products.description: A cropped bomber in suede with a curly shearling collar and full lining. Heavy, warm and built to last a decade.

collections.name: Obsidian Series
collections.label: New Collection
collections.description: Obsidian is a study in one colour. Dense wools, brushed cottons and soft leathers, all dyed to the same deep black, so the only thing left to read is the cut. Oversized coats, relaxed cargo and gathered leather — built to be worn together or not at all.

collections.name: Future Form
collections.label: Exclusive Drop
collections.description: Future Form takes the architecture of tailoring — the pleat, the lapel, the shoulder — and removes everything that restricts. Unstructured blazers, fluid trousers and fully-fashioned knits in bone and black.

collections.name: Terrain
collections.label: Outerwear Edit
collections.intro: Built for weather, cut for the city.
collections.description: Terrain is our outerwear programme. Waxed canvas, box-baffled down, suede and shearling — technical where it counts, restrained everywhere else.

collections.name: Core Program
collections.label: Always On
collections.intro: The pieces we never stop making.
collections.description: Heavyweight tees, 520 gsm fleece, Japanese denim and a leather court shoe. The permanent collection — refined every season, never replaced.

faq.question: What is your shipping policy?
faq.answer: Orders placed before 2 PM GMT on a business day ship the same day from our London studio. Standard shipping is free on orders over $150; below that, a flat $12 applies. Express delivery is available at checkout.

faq.question: What is your return policy?
faq.answer: You have 30 days from delivery to return unworn items with tags attached for a full refund or exchange. Start a return from your account or the link in your shipping email — returns are free for exchanges and $8 for refunds. Final-sale items are marked on the product page.

faq.question: How do I find my size?
faq.answer: Every product page includes a size guide with garment measurements, the fit (boxy, relaxed, oversized) and what size our model wears. As a rule, our tops are cut generously — take your usual size for the intended fit, or size down for a closer line. Still unsure? Email us your height and usual size and we'll advise within 24 hours.

faq.question: Do you offer international shipping?
faq.answer: Yes. We ship to over 60 countries with fully tracked, duties-paid delivery for the UK, EU, US, Canada, Australia and Japan — so the price you see at checkout is the price you pay. Other destinations may be subject to local import duties.

faq.question: How do I track my order?
faq.answer: As soon as your order leaves the studio you'll receive an email with a tracking link. You can also track any order from the Track Order page using your order number and email address.

faq.question: How should I care for my clothing?
faq.answer: Wash less, wash cold. Most of our jersey and fleece is pre-shrunk and garment-dyed, so wash inside out at 30°C and dry flat to preserve the weight and shape. Wool and tailoring should be brushed and steamed rather than washed. Specific care instructions are on every product page and garment label.
